title: Modellierung menschlichen Fahrverhaltens für die simulative Absicherung hoch-automatisierter Fahrzeuge
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
summary: For the development of highly automated driving, simulation tools and models for the behavior and interaction of traffic participants are of importance. Therefore, the aim of this work is to model the interaction between drivers at an intersection using game theoretical methods. The chosen white-box approach not only allows for the interpretation of the results, but also for influencing driving behavior by varying the model parameters.
